description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's commit-graph feature, including setup, verification, and various scenarios for writing, verifying, and manipulating commit-graph files and chains within Git repositories.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Sets expectations for reading and validating the commit-graph data, comparing the output of 'git test-tool read-graph' against expected headers and options.

methods.name: verify_chain_files_exist
methods.description: Checks whether all commit-graph chain files listed in the chain file exist.

methods.name: corrupt_file
methods.description: Corrupts a specified file at a given position with specified data to simulate corruptions for testing verification failures.
